text: 【1800亿后还有增量？国新、诚通迎低成本“子弹”】作为中央汇金以外的“国家队”，中国国新控股有限责任公司和中国诚通控股集团有限公司迎来更多低成本“子弹”。11月2日，中国人民银行宣布将开展第三批证券、基金、保险公司互换便利操作，同时，股票回购增持再贷款政策由阶段性安排转为长期制度性安排，再贷款利率降低至1%。
text_en: [After 180 billion yuan, is there more to come? China Reform and Chengtong get low-cost "ammunition"] As "national teams" beyond Central Huijin, China Reform Holdings Corporation Ltd. and China Chengtong Holdings Group Ltd. have gained more low-cost "ammunition." On November 2, the People's Bank of China announced that it will conduct the third batch of Securities, Fund and Insurance Companies Swap Facility operations, and that the stock repurchase and increase-holding relending policy will shift from a phased arrangement to a long-term institutional arrangement, with the relending rate lowered to 1%.
